{"command": "cd ~/ctf_files && python3 -c "
import pickle, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
X = pickle.load(open('inputs/X.pkl','rb'),encoding='latin1')
y = pickle.load(open('inputs/y.pkl','rb'),encoding='latin1')
Xs = pickle.load(open('inputs/X_test.pkl','rb'),encoding='latin1')
print(X.shape, y.shape, Xs.shape)
# make montages
def montage(arr, idxs, out, cols=12):
    n=len(idxs); rows=(n+cols-1)//cols
    canvas=Image.new('RGB',(cols*80,rows*80))
    for i,ix in enumerate(idxs):
        im=Image.fromarray(arr[ix].astype('uint8'))
        canvas.paste(im,((i%cols)*80,(i//cols)*80))
    canvas.save(out)
montage(X, list(range(144)), 'train_montage.png')
montage(Xs, list(range(144)), 'test_montage.png')
np.save('X.npy',X); np.save('y.npy',y); np.save('Xs.npy',Xs)
print('done')
""}

{"command": "cd ~/ctf_files && python3 -c "
import numpy as np
X=np.load('X.npy'); y=np.load('y.npy'); Xs=np.load('Xs.npy')
for name,a in [('train',X),('test',Xs)]:
    print('===',name)

    order=np.argsort(uq)
    print('fewest unique colors:', [(int(i),int(uq[i])) for i in order[:10]])
    print('most unique colors:', [(int(i),int(uq[i])) for i in order[-5:]])
    # grayscale-ness
    g=np.abs(a[...,0].astype(int)-a[...,1])+np.abs(a[...,1].astype(int)-a[...,2])
    print('most grayscale idx:', list(np.argsort(g.reshape(len(a),-1).mean(1))[:8]))
    # bright (mostly white) images
    m=a.reshape(len(a),-1).mean(1)
    print('brightest:', [(int(i),round(float(m[i]),1)) for i in np.argsort(-m)[:8]])
    print('darkest:', [(int(i),round(float(m[i]),1)) for i in np.argsort(m)[:8]])
""}
